reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the "Every batch lab-tested" line with the QR code, which is a nice touch, but I don't see an NSF or USP seal and there are zero reviews. I already take Pure Encapsulations or Thorne, and I'm not going to swap a brand I trust for an unknown one.
objection: A brand with no reviews and no NSF or USP seal. Their own QR report is a lab they picked, not a third-party certification I recognize. $29.99 for 30 days is also more per serving than what I pay now.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few hundred real verified reviews, or a lower price per serving to try it once.
